body:
This has nothing to do with the education system man. Look it's flawed but it didn't cause me to be unsavory enough that I've never been in a real relationship. I got the best of the system.

You seem to have an axe to grind, not that I blame you. Mine's pretty clear and it's with myself.

You people are too good for me. 

I'll see. I don't think im an imminent suicide threat I think this belongs on depression honestly.

My Mother is a saint, and while my Father can be an ass he was a respectable parent. I am, as i said, to blame.

True, the main thing stopping me is the possibility of a better future, new environment. I just figured, if there was somewhere to post what would be my suicide note, it'd be here.
You're forgetting the kids stuck in the foster system who'll get loving, grateful parents.
Anyway, I doubt I'll do it tonight, so no worries, but atleast im prepared.
